topp-02-c2.text: R. de-Picciotto, M. Reznikov, M. Heiblum, V. Umansky, G. Bunin, D. Mahalu (1997). Direct Observation of a Fractional Charge. arXiv (Nature 389, 162).

topp-04-c2.text: Markus König, Steffen Wiedmann, Christoph Brüne, Andreas Roth, Hartmut Buhmann, Laurens W. Molenkamp, Xiao-Liang Qi, Shou-Cheng Zhang (2007). Quantum Spin Hall Insulator State in HgTe Quantum Wells. arXiv (Science).

topp-05-c1.text: Alexei Kitaev (2001). Unpaired Majorana fermions in quantum wires. arXiv (Physics-Uspekhi 44, 131).
topp-05-c1.quote: Certain one-dimensional Fermi systems have an energy gap in the bulk spectrum while boundary states are described by one Majorana operator per boundary point.
topp-05-c1.claim: Kitaev (2001) wrote down the simplest model of a 1D topological superconductor

topp-05-c3.text: V. Mourik, K. Zuo, S. M. Frolov, S. R. Plissard, E. P. A. M. Bakkers, L. P. Kouwenhoven (2012). Signatures of Majorana fermions in hybrid superconductor-semiconductor nanowire devices. arXiv (Science).
topp-05-c3.quote: In the presence of magnetic fields of order 100 mT we observe bound, mid-gap states at zero bias voltage.
topp-05-c3.claim: Mourik et al. (2012) reported the first signatures: a zero-bias conductance peak in InSb/NbTiN nanowires.

topp-06-c3.text: Xie Chen, Zheng-Cheng Gu, Zheng-Xin Liu, Xiao-Gang Wen (2011). Symmetry protected topological orders and the group cohomology of their symmetry group. arXiv (Phys. Rev. B 87, 155114).
topp-06-c3.quote: distinct d-dimensional bosonic SPT phases with on-site symmetry G (which may contain anti-unitary time reversal symmetry) can be labeled by the elements in H^{1+d}[G, U_T(1)]
topp-06-c3.claim: Chen, Gu, Liu, and Wen (2011) gave a classification: bosonic SPT phases in d spatial dimensions with onsite symmetry G are labeled by the group cohomology H^{d+1}(G, U(1)).

topp-04-c3.text: Lukasz Fidkowski, Alexei Kitaev (2010). The effects of interactions on the topological classification of free fermion systems. arXiv (Phys. Rev. B 81, 134509).
topp-04-c3.quote: The topological invariant for the free fermion classification is an integer, but with the introduction of interactions it becomes well defined only modulo 8.
topp-04-c3.claim: the ℤ classification of 1D class-BDI superconductors collapses to ℤ_8 (Fidkowski-Kitaev 2010)

topp-07-c1.text: A. Yu. Kitaev (2003). Fault-tolerant quantum computation by anyons. Annals of Physics 303 (arXiv:quant-ph/9707021).
topp-07-c1.quote: A two-dimensional quantum system with anyonic excitations can be considered as a quantum computer.
topp-07-c1.claim: Kitaev (1997, published 2003) and Freedman-Larsen-Wang (2002) realized that non-abelian anyons could form the basis of a fault-tolerant quantum computer.

topp-07-c3.text: Parsa Bonderson, Michael Freedman, Chetan Nayak (2008). Measurement-Only Topological Quantum Computation. Physical Review Letters 101, 010501 (arXiv:0802.0279).
topp-07-c3.quote: By using an anyonic analog of quantum state teleportation, we show how the braiding transformations used to generate computational gates may be produced through a series of topological charge measurements.
topp-07-c3.claim: equivalent to braiding via the principle of measurement-only topological QC (Bonderson-Freedman-Nayak 2008)
